title: Chapter 58
text:
After figuring out the Favorability function, Han Xiao thought about it and felt that he had the function of selling things to players, so he let out a creepy laugh.

"Kid, you're not bad. I have high hopes for you. I will only sell things to the fated ones."

Mad Blade was going crazy, but when he heard this, he was dumbfounded again.

Eh, he lowered the Favorability and still said that he had high hopes for me? Is the Favorability in the game calculated in reverse? Why is this NPC laughing so creepily? So scary! I feel a chill down my spine!

So f * cking evil!

Do you want to open [Mad Blade Angry Blade]'s personal shop?

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. "Yes."

An illusory box that looked like a mission appeared in front of him, and it was split into two sides. The left side was' Item Shop ', which indicated that he could place his items in the list even if they were not on him. The right side was' Skill Shop ', where he could place his skills. Han Xiao tried placing a few items.

Please set a price for the item. Note: The price can be in currency, EXP, or barter.

You can also set the purchase conditions, including but not limited to Favorability, Level, Skill, Class …

The universe was vast, and there were many types of currencies. Aquamarine Dollar was only the currency of Blue Star, and the only currency in the universe was Enas. The type of currency could be set freely, but the prerequisite was that one had come into contact with it.

"This function is really complete!"

Han Xiao exclaimed. Suddenly, he realized that if he set a Favorability limit for the item, wouldn't the Favorability adjustment turn from useless to bait?

Oh my, isn't this the method developers use to keep players? Seduce … attract players to increase the Favorability of the NPC and forcefully increase the playtime of the players. Back then, he had to complete dozens of difficult missions to increase his Reputation with the [Radiant Federation] to Respect and buy the Glory Grade Main Ship.

Is this the song of a serf turning from the great freedom fighter of the proletariat into an unforgivable corrupt member of the capitalist class?

Amazing, my interface!

Han Xiao set the item and confirmed the release.

A shop interface appeared in front of Mad Blade Angry Blade. He looked at it, and his eyes were immediately attracted. He could not help but open his mouth wide, and his face turned red.

"Divine equipment!"

"Retractable knife, high explosive bullets, Type 73 Wasp pistol, Jason submachine gun, military knife rifle …"

Mad Blade's eyes turned red when he saw the attributes of the equipment. To him, these were all godly equipment. If he had these equipment, he would definitely be several levels ahead of all the other players!

When he looked at the price again, it was as if a bucket of ice water had been poured over him. He felt cold from head to toe, and his heart turned cold.

Even the cheapest high-explosive bullets cost a hundred each. Why don't you just rob a bank?

Also, the Lightweight Mechanical Arm required a favorability of 10 and above. Based on the NPC's quest to decrease favorability, did this mean that I would never be able to obtain this equipment?

No wonder the danger level is' Extremely Fatal '. This NPC is not someone that I should come into contact with at my level!

The Item Shop made Mad Blade so angry that he was about to go crazy. When he looked at the Skill Shop, he was instantly revived.

Basic Combat, Basic Shooting, Grappling … Just these common skills alone were enough to make Frenzied Sword drool. When he looked further down, he was immediately dumbfounded.

Mechanic Class Knowledge for Class Advancement!

There were also a bunch of Mechanic Class skills, but the one that shocked Mad Blade the most was none other than [Energy Training Technique]!

Godly skill! Mad Blade screamed in his heart.

Han Xiao suddenly shook his head. "Too bad you're not a Mechanic. You can't learn my skills."

Mad Blade was stunned. He was in a dilemma. He had already considered Han Xiao as a 'Mysterious Teacher' or a 'Hidden NPC'. This was definitely a rare opportunity. If he could learn from him, his growth speed would crush all the other players.

However, he favored the Pugilist class more. This could be seen from his ID.

After counting the money and experience he had, Mad Blade finally made up his mind. It was just enough for him to learn Basic Mechanic Knowledge.

If he did not grab this opportunity, he would definitely regret it for the rest of his life.

"I'll bet. I won't lose this time!"

"Do you want to change your class to Mechanic?"

"Yes!"

…

[Basic Weapon Knowledge] has been learned. You have received 500 EXP and 100 Aquamarine Dollars.

The cost of Mad Blade's skills would be handed over to Han Xiao. It was like school fees.

Teaching skills was equivalent to teaching, and his skills would not change.

The skills that Han Xiao chose to show were all carefully considered. First, he would definitely not sell the Advancement Knowledge and blueprints. He also did not show active combat skills like Slide Shot. Most of the skills that he taught were skills that could be easily obtained by players. Of course, most of the players did not know this yet.

For example, [Energy Training Technique] would definitely be awakened after the first Advancement at level 20. However, looking at how excited Mad Blade was, it was obvious that he did not know this.

Selling a skill that players would definitely learn in the future was like trying to get something for nothing!

However, Han Xiao knew the theory of hunger marketing. He set the price of [Energy Training Technique] at 10000 EXP and 3,000 Aquamarine Dollars. This was a huge sum for a newbie. Furthermore, he set the favorability level of Mad Blade to above ten. Thinking of this, Han Xiao quickly changed the favorability level of Mad Blade back to zero. He had to give his customers some confidence and hope.

Mad Blade immediately misunderstood. He thought that Han Xiao liked to make deals and only by buying things could he increase his favorability level. He secretly decided that he would patronize Han Xiao's business more in the future.

After testing the basic functions of the NPC, Han Xiao completed his goal and walked away.

Wah, don't go! I want to follow you, boss! Frenzied Sword panicked. "Where can I find you in the future?" he asked.

Han Xiao paused for a moment and wrote down the address of the repair shop on a piece of paper. He gave it to Mad Blade and walked away.

Frenzied Sword carefully put away the note as if he had found a treasure. He was excited. "This is my opportunity."

Those powerful mechanical equipment and skills were enough for him to be ahead of all the players. With such an advantage, he could definitely stand out.

However, the prerequisite was that this opportunity had to be enjoyed by him alone!

Mad Blade thought to himself. I can't let anyone find out about this hidden NPC!

…

The few beta testers were like a drop of water in a big city like the Western Capital. They were not eye-catching, and they were all poor people. Han Xiao was not interested in them at the moment. This trip was only to test the functions of the NPC. He was very satisfied with the result and started to think of all sorts of ways to scam the players.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes, and his thoughts drifted away. Scenes from his memories appeared one after another, and they were dyed with hazy colors.

In Han Xiao's previous life, Frenzied Sword was one of the first batch of professional players to participate in Galaxy. He was an expert in the Pugilist class. In the first season, he was in the limelight and became one of the top twenty-four players in the Huaxia region. He went out of the country to fight against foreign enemies. This honor made Frenzied Sword famous and established his position.

However, now, a future god-level Pugilist player had been tricked into becoming a Mechanic. It was hard to say what would happen in the future. At the very least, he would not have a chance to make a name for himself in the first and second season. He had missed out on the achievement that should have been his and walked on another path.

The reason Han Xiao dared to choose the Mechanic class was because he knew that the Mechanic class would be extremely powerful in the later stages of the game. However, the current players obviously did not know this. The Mechanic class was relatively weak in the early stages of the game. There were countless Mechanic players who changed their accounts because they felt that their future was bleak, and most of them were professional players.

Why do I feel like I've scammed him …
